variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'I will make mention of the deeds of Jehovah' renders the hiphil ketiv אזכיר (cause to remember, make mention). The qal qere אזכור would be 'I will remember', which the ASV reserves for the verse's second verb ('For I will remember thy wonders'), so the contrast in English wording is deliberate and follows the ketiv.
